verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a native access-review feature. It reminds teams to start reviews on their policy's timelines, suggests in-scope systems, validates access changes before a review is finished, and reuses prior review data (Head Start). It also automates evidence gathering for audits, but only "when applicable", and the evidence does not show user lists being pulled from connected apps or an explicit reviewer sign-off step. missing for 10: explicit documentation that reviews pull user access data from connected integrations, a documented in-app reviewer sign-off/attestation step, confirmation that the completed review artifact reliably lands in the evidence library (the docs qualify it with "when applicable"), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library

citations.quote: Access reviews with Thoropass will: Remind you to to start your reviews according to your policy's timelines... Automate the gathering of evidence for audits (when applicable).
Suggest the most important in-scope and critical systems to review.
Validate your access changes before finishing your review, preventing costly errors in your change management process.

Thoropass is the only compliance solution that offers optimized consecutive access reviews automation, allowing you to focus only on changes since the last review and saving up to 95% of the workload.
